reauth_confirm.description: The add-on rejected the stored token. A fresh one is filled in below if the add-on left one.

data_description.model: Faster models answer voice commands sooner; stronger models handle complex requests better.
data_description.prompt: Instructions given to Claude at the start of every conversation.
data_description.web_access: Let this agent search and fetch the web. Off by default: it makes every turn slower and more expensive, and an Assist turn runs unattended for anyone who can talk to a voice satellite. It never grants shell or file access.
data_description.effort: How hard Claude thinks before answering. Higher is slower and costs more; lower suits voice, where a quick answer beats a thorough one. Leave empty to use Claude Code's own default.

cannot_connect.message: Sorry, the Claude add-on isn't responding.

invalid_auth.message: Sorry, the Claude add-on rejected its access token. Reconnect the integration in Settings.

busy.message: Sorry, Claude is busy right now. Try again in a moment.

timeout.message: Sorry, Claude took too long to answer.

unsupported_attachment.message: Sorry, I can't look at images yet.

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish updating Claude
restart_required.description:
The Claude Code Agent add-on has installed version {deployed} of its Home Assistant integration, but Home Assistant is still running version {running}. New options and fixes will not appear until you restart.

Go to Settings > System and select Restart Home Assistant. Reloading the integration is not enough — custom integrations are only loaded when Home Assistant starts.
